ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\angle BAE=\angle CAF=110^\circ$, $\angle CAE=60^\circ$, and $AD$ is the angle bisector of $\angle BAF$. What is the measure of $\angle BAD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle$BAE$=110^\circ$, $\angle$CAE$=60^\circ$,

therefore $\angle$BAC$=110^\circ-60^\circ=50^\circ$,

and since $\angle$CAF$=110^\circ$,

therefore $\angle$BAF$=110^\circ+50^\circ=160^\circ$,

and since AD is the angle bisector of $\angle$BAF,

therefore $\angle$BAD= $\frac{1}{2}$ $\angle$BAF= $\frac{1}{2}$ $\times160^\circ=\boxed{80^\circ}$.
